purpose: Bracket-targeting parameters for the BDE recommendation engine, derived from the measured cross-bracket analysis. Consumed by both the deck CLASSIFIER (deck -> bracket) and the GENERATOR (target tuple -> deck).

confidence.structure: HIGH — two-band step function, GC gate, four discriminators, B4=B5 collapse are robust even at current n.
confidence.exact_thresholds: PROVISIONAL — numeric medians/cutoffs rest on n=1-4 per bracket (MEASURED_UNDERSAMPLED). Re-fit against the n>=8 Topdeck.gg backfill before hardening.
confidence.drift: All soft values re-fit on each ban-list / major-set update. WHICH metrics matter is stable; their target values are not.

metric_definitions._change: SPLIT the old combined fast_mana metric. See reference/category-definitions.md v2.
metric_definitions.fast_mana_rocks: 0-2 MV mana rocks that net-positive + rituals (Sol Ring, Mana Crypt, Mana Vault, Grim Monolith, the Moxen, Lotus Petal, Chrome Mox, Mox Diamond, signets/talismans that net, Dark/Cabal/Pyretic/Rite-of-Flame rituals, Jeska's Will). THIS IS A BRACKET SIGNAL.
metric_definitions.mana_dork_count: 1-2 MV creatures that tap for mana (Birds, Elves, Bloom Tender, etc.). THIS IS A THEME/POSTURE SIGNAL, NOT A BRACKET SIGNAL — do not feed into the bracket score.
metric_definitions.free_interaction: 0-generic-mana interaction via alt cost (FoW, Force of Negation, Fierce Guardianship, Pact of Negation, Mental Misstep, Deflecting Swat, Deadly Rollick, pitch elementals). BRACKET SIGNAL.
metric_definitions.compact_win_lines: distinct <=2-card infinite/game-ending combos, via Commander Spellbook intersection; cite the pairs. BRACKET SIGNAL.
metric_definitions.game_changer_count: cards on the current 53-card Game Changers list (Scryfall is:gamechanger). PRIMARY GATE + BRACKET SIGNAL.
metric_definitions.card_advantage_engines: DROPPED as a bracket signal (measured flat 5/4/5/4). Keep only as a deck-completeness quality check (~4 desired at any bracket).
metric_definitions.tutor_count: DROPPED as a bracket gate (WotC removed the tutor rule 2025-10-21). Soft consistency signal only.

bracket_classifier.note: Do NOT interpolate bracket linearly 1..5. There is a discontinuity at the B3->B4 seam. Classify band first, then place within band.

also_forces_high_band: any fast (pre-turn-6) two-card infinite combo present

power_package_score.purpose: refine placement + confidence near band edges; NOT the primary gate (GC is).

within_band.low_band: Distinguish B1/B2/B3 primarily by game_changer_count (0 & thematic -> B1; 0 -> B2; 1-3 -> B3) and secondarily by curve/quality (avg_mv, finisher tier). B2 vs B3 is NOT soft-metric separable — lean on the GC gate.
within_band.high_band: Do NOT attempt to separate B4 from B5 by deck contents (metrically identical). Split ONLY by user-supplied intent flag (see b4_b5_policy).

generation_targets._note: Median targets from analysis/measured-baselines.md (MEASURED_UNDERSAMPLED n=1-4). Use as centers; widen tolerance until n>=8 backfill.

1.note: Exhibition: definitions-only, theme-driven. No metric target. GC=0, no combos/MLD/extra-turns.

3.width: WIDE — offer casual-B3 (fast_rocks ~0, GC 0) vs high-B3 (fast_rocks ~2, GC ~3) sub-target

b4_b5_policy.rule: B4 and B5 share ONE generation profile (generation_targets.4_5_shared). They are not machine-separable by contents.
b4_b5_policy.b4: shared profile, no metagame tuning ('best version of a fun strategy').
b4_b5_policy.b5: shared profile PLUS metagame tuning: bias card choices toward answers for the current top-conversion commanders (see rubrics/bracket5.json meta_performance_verified).
b4_b5_policy.engine_must_not: spend model capacity trying to make a deck 'B4 not B5' or vice-versa from card contents.

3.reason: degenerate in sample; casual B3 all midrange

ui_contract.surfaced_fallback: If a requested posture/theme cell is UNDERSAMPLED or absent, disclose in output which requested dimensions actually shaped the deck (shaped_by + confidence_notes). Silent fallback prohibited.

retune_policy.action: regenerate soft thresholds + generation targets from a fresh harvest; regenerate the selectable_posture_map (posture deltas drift fastest). Never freeze soft values into the UI.
retune_policy.hard_constraints_source: reference/foundations.md + reference/game-changers.md (VERIFIED WotC text). Stable; change only on official rule updates.

coverage_guard.purpose: After each set release or tag update, flag decklist cards that have ZERO oracle tags from any source. These cards fall through the classifier and must get an oracle-text heuristic fallback.

data_sources._note: Multi-source ensemble. No single tag source covers all bracket metrics. Each metric reads from its declared source; the coverage_guard flags gaps.

fast_mana_rocks_dorks_rituals.oracle_text_test: net-positive mana on cast turn for rocks; mana ability for dorks; one-shot for rituals
fast_mana_rocks_dorks_rituals.seed_from: bracket calculator premium + common fast mana lists (ScrollVault/Moxfield/Archidekt)
fast_mana_rocks_dorks_rituals.refresh: on set release — check new 0-2 MV artifacts with mana abilities

free_interaction.definition: 0-generic-mana interaction via alternative cost (pitch, pact, evoke, flare)
free_interaction.refresh: on set release — check new alt-cost interaction

combos.fallback: mark compact_win_lines as unknown, surface in confidence_notes

interaction_tags.refresh: weekly or on tagger data update

edhrec_meta.reason: EDHREC Ramp bucket conflates rocks+dorks; not granular enough for bracket metrics

tag_rollup_map._note: Maps tagger-tags.json tag names to bracket metrics. Tags listed here are verified present in the local tagger data (2026-07-07). De-dup rule: a card with multiple tags is counted ONCE per target metric.

total_interaction.dedup: per-card: count each card at most once toward total_interaction

free_interaction.supplement: curated list data/free-interaction-list.json — no tagger tag for free/alt-cost interaction exists

stax_piece_count.supplement: oracle-text heuristic or future curated list — no stax/tax/lock tags in current tagger data
stax_piece_count.note: PROVISIONAL — stax detection deferred until tagger adds these tags or a curated list is built

card_advantage.note: DROPPED as bracket signal; quality check only

available_tags._note: All tags in tagger-tags.json as of 2026-07-07 with card counts

bracket_ground_truth._note: Regression fixtures for cross-validation. Each deck's bracket was verified against Moxfield, Archidekt, and ScrollVault bracket outputs.
